# Becky the Bat
> Free offline arcade flyer game. Fly Becky across famous cities, dodge obstacles, collect hearts, and chase high scores.

- Site: https://beckythebat.com
- Play in browser: https://beckythebat.com/play.html
- Privacy: https://beckythebat.com/privacy.html
- Support: https://beckythebat.com/support.html

## Product facts
- Free to play in the browser
- Offline-friendly after load
- Casual endless flyer with city scenery
- Hearts as continue currency; native App Store path when published
